item.description: UI Athletics news release IOWA CITY, Iowa — The 23rd-ranked University of Iowa football team will face No. 14 Vanderbilt in the 2025 Reliaquest Bowl on Dec. 31, in Tampa, Florida. Kickoff is set for 11 a.m. (CT)

item.title: Colts QB Daniel Jones suffers Achilles injury in loss to Jaguars; may be out for season
item.description: Indianapolis Colts quarterback Daniel Jones exited Sunday’s crucial AFC South matchup against the Jacksonville Jaguars after a non contact injury to his lower right leg, an issue quickly ruled an Achilles injury and feared to be season-ending.

item.title: Gas prices dip ahead of the holidays
item.description: Hunter 12/08/25 Gas prices have dipped significantly in Iowa, according to the latest figures from Gas Buddy. The latest figures show the average cost for a gallon of gas among the over 2000 stations surveyed is $2.55.
